quotes.text: For email Details, selecting the owner window and selecting view versus modify mode are separate choices.
This patch is local and uncommitted in the Thunderbird checkout. It has not been submitted, reviewed, accepted, or landed.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: For email X-SHOWDETAILS, choosing the main calendar window fixes document lookup, while choosing view mode also clears args.inTab and bypasses editor tabs for editable published events. A provisional Bug 2073142 patch based on 2135bbdeb7dd3feafb298c0220b412a66cc41826 reportedly calls modifyEventWithDialog when calendar.item.editInTab is true and retains viewing otherwise. Invitations and read-only events retain their summary branch. This is a local, uncommitted proposal, not an accepted routing convention. The note reports passing native headless tests covering message pane, message tab, standalone window, both read-dialog preferences, and protected items. Coverage used artifact binaries; no full native compilation, Try run, recurrence prompt, event save, live accessibility check, or release-156 binary test ran.
title: Owner window and dialog mode are separate choices
